name: Dimension Drift
description: 🌌 Transform GD into a dynamic 2.5D experience! Objects exist on Z-layers (-10 to +10), camera drifts in sync with music, and perspective creates stunning depth. Features multiple camera modes: Classic, Ortho-3D, Drift, Cosmic, Hyper, and Beat-Sync!

enabled.name: ✨ Enable Dimension Drift
enabled.description: Master toggle for the 2.5D depth effect.

z-spread.name: 📊 Z-Layer Spread
z-spread.description: How far objects spread across Z-layers. Higher = more 3D depth.

drift-amplitude.name: 🌊 Drift Amplitude
drift-amplitude.description: How far the camera drifts in Drift modes.

perspective.name: 🔭 Perspective Strength
perspective.description: How strong the 3D perspective effect is.

glow-intensity.name: 💡 Glow Intensity
glow-intensity.description: How bright the depth glow effect is.

z-gravity.name: 🌍 Z-Affected Gravity
z-gravity.description: Objects on different Z-layers have modified gravity. Experimental!

z-collisions.name: 💥 Z-Layer Collisions
z-collisions.description: Only collide with objects on similar Z-layers. Very experimental!

collision-tolerance.name: 📏 Collision Z-Tolerance
collision-tolerance.description: How close in Z objects need to be to collide.

auto-seed.name: 🎲 Auto-Seed
auto-seed.description: Automatically generate seed from level ID for consistent Z-layers.

manual-seed.name: 🔢 Manual Seed
manual-seed.description: Seed for Z-layer randomization (when auto-seed is off).

beat-reactivity.name: 🎵 Beat Reactivity
beat-reactivity.description: How strongly camera reacts to beats in Beat-Sync mode.
